## Campaign URLs

Generate with `node scripts/campaign-url.mjs`.

- [ ] LinkedIn launch URL uses `utm_source=linkedin`, `utm_medium=social`, `utm_content=launch`.
- [ ] Carousel URL uses `utm_source=linkedin`, `utm_medium=social`, `utm_content=carousel`.
- [ ] Follow-up URL uses `utm_source=linkedin`, `utm_medium=social`, `utm_content=followup`.
- [ ] Digest URL uses `utm_source=newsletter`, `utm_medium=email`, `utm_content=digest`.
- [ ] Community/referral URLs are generated only for selective outreach.

## Distribution Package

- [ ] LinkedIn launch post is copy-ready.
- [ ] 6-8 slide PDF carousel source is complete.
- [ ] Carousel export is readable on mobile and points to the canonical article.
- [ ] Focused follow-up post is copy-ready.
- [ ] Monthly digest entry is ready for the future digest.
- [ ] Selective outreach note is respectful and relevant.
